    Band modules are indecomposable #

    At a primitive band, an idempotent endomorphism of M(b, t) that is zero on the one-dimensional pair functor at first is zero on every pair functor (shift isomorphisms and position counts), hence zero (spanning lemma). As the functor at first is one-dimensional, one of the two projections of a decomposition has this property (isIndecomposable).

    (∀ x ∈ n₁, g x ∈ d₁) ↔ ∀ x ∈ n₂, g x ∈ d₂

    An endomorphism commuting with a shift isomorphism kills the pair functor on one side iff on the other.
